Exercise: Seated Overhead Stretch

Category:
stretching

Exercise Type:
isolation

Force Type:
static

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- lateral_flexion
- torso_rotation

Primary Muscles:

- abdominals

Secondary Muscles:
None

Equipment:
None

Fatigue Score:
2

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.75

Energy Requirement:
low

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- improve_spinal_flexibility
- relieve_muscle_tension

Contraindications:

- lower back pain

Exercise Variations:
None

Substitution Options:
None

Instructions:

- Sit up straight on an exercise mat.
- Touch the soles of your feet together with your feet six to eight inches in front of your hips.
- Place one hand on the floor beside you and your other hand behind your head.
- Lift your elbow to the ceiling as you incline your torso to the other side. Hold for 10 to 20 seconds, then switch sides.
